angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 740,921 km at 186.23 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.3698 +/- 0.0103 mas (same row, RUWE 0.90): 186.23 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.065 +/- 0.009 solar radii from Dumusque et al. 2014, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-10 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...789..154D/abstract): 740,921 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.91 +/- 0.021 solar masses from Dumusque et al. 2014, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of Kepler-10 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...789..154D/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5708 +/- 28 K from Dumusque et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-10 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...789..154D/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Dumusque et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-10 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...789..154D/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kepler-10.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.342, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-10 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.15 dex, from Dumusque et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...789..154D/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-10 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.05467, from Gajdoš et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019RAA....19...41G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-10 (pscomppars): age 10.6 Gyr, from Dumusque et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...789..154D/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of Kepler-10 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.04 km/s, from Dumusque et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...789..154D/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
